purpose: Teach: つたの/見込ま/名づけ/転がっ/くっつい/とどまる/はじまる/かかえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、フェンスにつたのからまる公園、素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, that park with ivy crawling up the fence — it's lovely, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Gentle voice lifting on the memory. Eyes soft with affection for the place and the boy. Unhurried, like she's sharing something she noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがぼくの将来を見込まれてるって嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad says he believes in me — and that makes me so happy.
lines.style: Bright, earnest. Quick eagerness in the delivery but genuine underneath. Sho trusts her with the feeling. No performance, just the relief of saying something that matters to someone safe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい鉢植えに名づけて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to name his new potted plant, apparently.
lines.style: Soft, slightly amused observation. A small knowing pause before 'apparently' — Mei noticing the tenderness in Ryosuke's gesture. Voice warm but not intruding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとボールが転がっていく方を追って遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played with Dad at the park — we chased after the ball rolling down the hill.
lines.style: Bright, eager. Words tumbling out a little fast. Pride in having his father's attention, in being the one who ran with him. Simple joy, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに翔くんがくっついてらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, you were stuck to your father like glue the whole time, weren't you?
lines.style: Tender, teasing without sting. A gentle observation spoken with genuine affection. Like she's watching something unfold that she knows matters. Slight warmth in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園にとどまる時間が長くなったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we stayed at the park for so much longer than usual.
lines.style: Quietly pleased. The words are simple but weighted with the feeling of time stretching out, of not wanting it to end. Sho is noticing something changing, and he's glad about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお話がはじまると時間を忘れるわ
lines.en: Sho, once your father gets talking, time just disappears, doesn't it?
lines.style: Soft, reflective. A knowing smile in the voice. Mei is recognizing something tender happening — the way good conversations erase time. Unhurried, intimate without being intrusive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが重いお米をかかえてお家に持ち帰られたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, on the way home, Dad carried this really heavy bag of rice — the whole way.
lines.style: Awed, admiring. Sho is noticing his father's strength, his care, his steadiness. The delivery is hushed with wonder at this ordinary, impossible thing. Genuine pride in his father.
